content:
The latest stable release v4.5.0 for Lean is out now!

The release brings:

  • updates to the widgets framework allowing more persistent widgets
  • more feedback and automation around termination proofs
  • improvements to the output of simp? and simp_all?
  • string gaps and raw strings

as well as many bug fixes to Lean and Lake.

We encourage everyone using previous stable releases to update their repositories to v4.5.0.

Std, Aesop, and Mathlib are all now available for v4.5.0

  • the stable branch on each repository has been updated to use v4.5.0
  • there is a v4.5.0 tag in each repository if you would like to pin to a commit using this toolchain.

The release candidate for v4.6.0, with many new features, will be arriving soon!
